# CloudSky
Made for HelpGrandmaOut; Hackclub

**Instructions**
Hello! Welcome to "CloudSky". CloudSky is a song that I created with code using the software "Strudel." I learned how to use this tool through the Hack Club program "Aria" and decided to create another project on it for another program. The prompts I was given were; "A hard size cap for your category: about 500 lines of code or 10 components, The README is readable by a non-programmer, Only two colors in the whole visual output." Moreover, how the code works is whenever it says "$: note" that means the letters and numbers represent the note in music alongside the octave, if it says "$: sound" that means its a sound for a drum/drum part, ".sound("")" is what sound/ instrument should be used for the code written in that line(s), "pan(0).color("")" just changes the colour of the box that shows what sound is currently playing. Anyways, **To use it:** click on the link below and it should take you to the code. In order to play it, press ctrl + enter, to stop ctrl + "." If you want to add on or change or learn how to use strudel I advise that you go through the Strudel tutorial which you can do by clicking "learn" in the top right corner when you go on my song. Enjoy!
